text:
mina: Quick sync: we're kicking off a focused curation + smoke for qx6b-int6 (code + convo). Need 1k stratified sample, dedupe, 150 golden priority, and basic auto-evals.

carlos: I'll produce stratified sample. Use traffic-weighted buckets: short/medium/long = 60/30/10. Add 120 code prompts and 80 multi-turn convs.

evan: For dedupe, use fuzzy 0.84 then exact fingerprint. Also run a tokenizer-diff against q6b-hosted to catch tokenization drift.

label_ops: We can take priority:qbringup. With 2 labelers initial 150 golden in ~4 hrs. Tag ambiguous cases with "needs-review".

mina: Add automated checks: truncated code block detector and json-output sanity. If malformed JSON rate > 3% mark regression.

qa-bot: CI job queued: canary/qx6b-int6-smoke #78 by mina. Logs: https://ci.redwood/run/78 :robot_face:

carlos: sample command (local):
```
rbatch sample --model qx6b-int6 --n 1000 --seed 7 --out /tmp/qx6b-smoke.json
```

evan: After dedupe, run evals: perplexity delta, token-overlap, answer-sanity. Export CSV with stable sample ids.

mina: OK. plan: 1) sample by noon 2) dedupe and seed label queue 3) run auto-evals 4) manual compare vs qx4b/q6b 5) triage. If any metric regresses >5% we halt canary.

label_ops: Received. Will ping when first 50 golden complete for quick triage.

carlos: dropping artifacts to /datasets/curation/qx6b-int6-smoke/ and metrics stub to /reports/qx6b-int6-smoke/metrics.csv

mina: thanks. will open canary at 1% with auto-fallback to q6b-hosted and lock alias mapping. Update here with results. :thumbsup:
